name: Mills Setting
implementation_notes: First-time implementation of two new entity-catalog v7 pieces: `mill-setting` (new table, 1:1 with business_units, lazily auto-created via MillSettingService::getOrCreate() — no backfill migration needed, pre-existing Business Units get a default row on first access) and `station.icon` (new nullable string column, added via migration ONLY — no data existed to migrate since entity-catalog v6's short-lived `station.image` field was replaced by `icon` before any implementation ever touched it).

Response fields `logo`/`home_page_image` are exposed as their fully-resolved Storage::url() under the BARE key name (no `_url` suffix) — deliberately matches GET /api/mill-settings/current's already-written tech-spec contract (screen-005--home, consumed directly as an src by mobile) rather than BusinessUnitService's `logo` (raw path) + `logo_url` (resolved) pair convention, since this screen shares the exact same `mill-setting` entity/response shape with that sibling screen.

This is the FIRST screen in this codebase with genuine per-resource (not just per-role) access control: MillSettingService::checkAccess() rejects a Mill Management user acting on any business_unit_id other than their own (user.business_unit_id), on every method including GET, before any MillSetting/Station row is queried — Admin is never restricted. Enforced identically from both the API controller and the Livewire component (both call the same service).

station.icon is a picker over a fixed allow-list (MillSettingService::SUPPORTED_ICONS — gauge/layers/package/truck/scale/warehouse/factory/container/box/boxes), NOT a file upload — validated via Rule::in(), no Laravel Filesystem storage involved for this field. null resets a station to its type-default icon (Gauge/Layers/Package per uiux-spec component_patterns 'station-tile' — that fallback rendering logic itself belongs to screen-006--station-list's own Phase 4, not implemented here).

New route group `/api/mill-settings/{businessUnitId}/...` added to routes/api.php with an explicit comment: GET /api/mill-settings/current (screen-005--home's read-only, self-scoped endpoint) MUST be registered BEFORE the parameterized {businessUnitId} route once screen-005's own Phase 4 adds it, or Laravel would match the literal 'current' segment against the route parameter instead.

New web route `/mill-settings` (name: mill-settings) added to routes/web.php, guarded by 'auth' + 'role:admin,mill_management' — the first web screen in this codebase accessible to a role set narrower than the existing 'admin,supervisor,mill_management'/'admin' patterns.

Own shell layout (resources/views/settings/mill-settings.blade.php) added, listing all existing master-data/data-browser/settings nav links plus this screen's own — mirrors the newest existing shell (master-data/machinery.blade.php) but does NOT retrofit the new 'Mills Setting' nav link into any OTHER screen's own shell file, consistent with this codebase's established pattern (each shell is a static per-screen snapshot, never kept in sync retroactively — verified: machinery.blade.php's own nav also lacks links to some earlier screens' most-recent additions).

GET/POST /api/mill-settings/{businessUnitId}/stations endpoints are DELIBERATELY separate from screen-030's existing /api/stations (Admin-only) rather than reusing it, so Mill Management can manage their own mill's station icons without being granted full Kelola Station access.
Independently re-verified: re-ran `php artisan test` (full suite) — 644/644 passed, no regressions in any other screen's tests.

REVISI v2 (2026-10-03, perbaikan tampilan + uji): subtitle halaman di resources/views/livewire/settings/mills-setting.blade.php tidak lagi menyebut 'jumlah cages' (field itu sudah dihapus 2026-08-20) — kini 'Atur nama aplikasi, logo, gambar halaman utama, pengiriman data langsung, dan icon station untuk mill Anda.' e2e-web/tests/mills-setting.spec.ts dijalankan: 6 lulus, 1 dilewati (skenario 'Validasi jumlah cages' di-skip karena field-nya tidak ada lagi); test_results.browser diperbarui. Known issue 'browser test tidak dijalankan' dihapus.
REVISI (2026-10-03): entri backend/tests/Browser/* dihapus dari daftar berkas — direktori itu dihapus di 8879d8d; uji browser kini di e2e-web/tests/.

REVISI (2026-10-04, audit-fix — sinkronisasi artefak, kode adalah acuan): MillsSetting kini punya rules()/messages() sendiri (seluruhnya Indonesia): app_name WAJIB (dulu nullable → mengosongkan tetap 'berhasil disimpan'); MillSettingService::update() menolak app_name yang DIKIRIM kosong (Rule::requiredIf kunci ada; kunci absen = tidak diubah). Logo & home_page_image ditambah App\Rules\RealImage (isi file harus JPG/PNG sungguhan) di Livewire dan service, dan divalidasi saat dipilih lewat trait App\Livewire\Concerns\ValidatesUploadOnSelect (pratinjau disembunyikan selama ada error). Pemilih Mill (Admin) dan pemilih icon per station memakai x-searchable-select (stationIcons.<id> → updatedStationIcons() → setStationIcon()). Daftar station menampilkan kolom Production Line (mapStations: production_line_name, urut nama line lalu nama station) dan label tipe dari StationService::typeLabels(). Mobile: millSettingRepo.getMillSetting() kini ikut SELECT immediate_sync_enabled — sebelumnya selalu terbaca false sehingga pengaturan 'Kirim data langsung' di layar ini tidak pernah berlaku di perangkat. Uji: MillsSettingAuditTest.php, ImageUploadValidationTest.php, MillSettingServiceTest.php/MillSettingTest.php (diperbarui), mobile/tests/millSettingRepo.sqljs.spec.ts, mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts, e2e-web/tests/mills-setting.spec.ts (diperbarui).

REVISI (2026-10-05, artifact-sync round 3 — commit 658cedc, c321f32, kode adalah acuan): pemilih mill khusus Admin dipindah ke x-filter.bar bersama (label 'Pilih mill', field 'Mill', placeholder 'Pilih mill'; tanpa total/Reset; kelas ms-filter* dihapus). Loading (c321f32): form dan bagian daftar station memakai ld-region yang meredup saat selectedBusinessUnitId (dan stationIcons) berubah; Simpan memakai x-busy-label ('Menyimpan…') dan nonaktif selama save maupun unggahan logo/home_page_image (wire:target="save,logo,home_page_image"); petunjuk 'Mengunggah…' ber-spinner di bawah kedua kolom gambar.

known_issues.description: Station-tile's type-default icon fallback rendering (Gauge/Layers/Package when station.icon is null) is NOT implemented here — that belongs to screen-006--station-list's own Phase 4 (mobile), which consumes this screen's data but is out of this screen's scope.
